name: Lint eslint

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, test ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: lint-eslint-${{ github.head_ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read

    outputs:
      src: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.src}}

    steps:
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@de90cc6fb38fc0963ad72b210f1f284cd68cea36 # v3.0.2
        id: changes
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          filters: |
            src:
              - '.github/workflows/**'
              - 'src/**'
              - 'appinfo/info.xml'
              - 'package.json'
              - 'package-lock.json'
              - 'tsconfig.json'
              - '.eslintrc.*'
              - '.eslintignore'
              - '**.js'
              - '**.ts'
              - '**.vue'

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src != 'false'

    name: NPM lint

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@8e8c483db84b4bee98b60c0593521ed34d9990e8 # v6.0.1

      - name: Read package.json node and npm engines version
        uses: skjnldsv/read-package-engines-version-actions@06d6baf7d8f41934ab630e97d9e6c0bc9c9ac5e4 # v3
        id: versions
        with:
          fallbackNode: '^20'
          fallbackNpm: '^10'

      - name: Set up node ${{ steps.versions.outputs.nodeVersion }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@395ad3262231945c25e8478fd5baf05154b1d79f # v6.1.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.nodeVersion }}

      - name: Set up npm ${{ steps.versions.outputs.npmVersion }}
        run: npm i -g 'npm@${{ steps.versions.outputs.npmVersion }}'

      - name: Install dependencies
        env:
          CYPRESS_INSTALL_BINARY: 0
          PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD: true
        run: npm ci

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint

  summary:
    permissions:
      contents: none
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [changes, lint]

    if: always()

    # This is the summary, we just avoid to rename it so that branch protection rules still match
    name: eslint

    steps:
      - name: Summary status
        run: if ${{ needs.changes.outputs.src != 'false' && needs.lint.result != 'success' }}; then exit 1; fi

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
